thread.title: Watch Apple, AT&T Earnings As Dollar Strengthens Vs. China, India, Mexico - Investor's Business Daily

title: Watch Apple, AT&T Earnings As Dollar Strengthens Vs. China, India, Mexico - Investor's Business Daily
text:
Add Apple ( AAPL ) and AT&T ( T ) to the growing list of U.S. technology stocks that could be impacted by a rising U.S. dollar when they report earnings.
X China's yuan on Monday fell to its lowest level against the U.S. dollar since mid-August 2017. China is a key market for Apple's iPhone sales.
In a report on Monday, Morgan Stanley cited telecom companies with exposure to the rising U.S. dollar.
"Weaker currencies vs. the U.S. dollar have a been a consistent topic in recent months and are likely to be a headwind to guidance/consensus estimates," Morgan Stanley analyst Simon Flannery said in a note to clients. The impact could come, he added, "as we move through second-quarter earnings season, particularly for American Tower ( AMT ), SBA Communications ( SBAC ) and Equinix ( EQIX )."

Please contact customer service CLOSE AT&T Exposure In Mexico In AT&T's case, Flannery notes the exposure of its wireless business in Mexico as well as its satellite TV business. DirecTV sells pay-TV services in Brazil. The U.S. dollar has strengthened against currencies from Brazil, Mexico and Canada, the analyst said.
AT&T recently updated financial guidance, following its purchase of Time Warner . AT&T stock closed up 0.3% to 32.21 in the stock market today . Apple rose 1.1% to 187.18.
Shares in American Tower edged up 0.4% to 144.67. to 143.07. SBA Communications slipped 0.3% to 164.69. Equinix, a data center operator, was down 0.4% to 428.21.
The euro and British pound also have weakened vs. the dollar.
Other companies to watch include Zayo ( ZAYO ) and CenturyLink ( CTL ), Flannery said.
Akamai Technologies ( AKAM ) and Red Hat ( RHT ), an enterprise software provider, recently lowered revenue guidance. Akamai and Red Hat cited the strengthening dollar.
Apple IPhone Sales In China, India Technology stocks, including Apple, got a boost from a weak dollar in the March quarter and in late 2017. Aside from impacting overseas earnings, a rising dollar also makes U.S. products more expensive.
China's yuan suffered its worst ever month against the dollar in June. China is a key market for Apple, as is India. Apple may not feel the impact until its September quarter.
"More recently the Indian rupee has fallen to record lows on concerns over trade and oil prices," Flannery said.
